#### Testing whether a linear score is an affine map

Some results hold only for [affine maps](#def-affine-map),
so it helps to check whether a given score qualifies.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals$ be $f(\vx) = x_1 - 4 x_2$,
a [linear map](#def-linear-map).

Is $f$ an [affine map](#def-affine-map)?
